interfaceMatrix.scope: UI localization/layout QA uses a 5fps requestAnimationFrame cap to prevent software-GPU contention; not a performance benchmark.

finalWordingPass.scope: Final translated text on desktop and portrait mobile; one renderer reused per layout. The later change only widens the mobile settings select.
finalWordingPass.note: Three short French settings labels were refined after the captured matrix; their interpolation fields and layout structure are unchanged.

gameAudio.method: Actual browser Web Audio graph driven through the game UI; an AnalyserNode measured its output. A native silent sink bypassed intermittent Windows audio-device errors. No mocked audio engine.
covered: Trusted gesture unlock; no context created beforehand
Nonzero ambient signal and footsteps during actual movement
Settings pause and mute suspend the context
Volume changes output amplitude and survives reload
Vehicle idle, acceleration, coasting and exit
Merchant confirmation cue while movement is paused
Transient cleanup and bounded continuous graph
limits: These measurements validate real browser DSP signal and lifecycle; they are not a physical speaker or listening test.
This is functional audio QA, not a performance benchmark.
Hidden-document semantics are unit-tested; the final browser pass did not freeze the renderer or emulate document visibility.
gameAudio.cleanup: Owned browser exited; its waiting harness process was terminated after all measurements were saved.

providers: See language-validation.json for live text and speech checks.

deployment.reason: Local DNS could not resolve api.machines.dev or api.depot.dev. Hosted release remains unchanged.

mobileSettings.scope: All ten languages at 390px; Hindi and French also checked at 320px. Native selected-option text fits available width.
